objectives: IM3059*是一門了解行銷觀念的基礎課程。本門課程旨在(1)協助學生了解行銷於組織及商業環境中所扮演的角色；(2)讓學生熟習行銷管理之基本概念(例：行銷策略、行銷研究、消費者行為、STP等）；(3)強調學生對於行銷策略與行銷戰術之應用；(4)培養學生團隊合作、分析與解決行銷問題的能力。課程內容會融入國、內外之實務案例來闡述行銷觀念的應用，藉以提升同學對行銷議題的興趣。
content:
Defining marketing for the new realities (Chapter 1)
Marketing planning and management (Chapter 2)
Analyzing consumer markets (Chapter 3)
Conducting marketing research (Chapter 5)

Selecting target market(s) (Chapter 6)
Crafting a customer value proposition and positioning (Chapter 7)
Designing and managing products (chapter 8)
Designing and managing services (Chapter 9)
Building strong brands (chapter 10)
Managing marketing communication (Chapter 12)
Designing an integrated marketing campaign in the digital age (Chapter 13)
Socially responsible marketing (chapter 21)
books: Kotler, P. and Keller, K.L. (2022), Marketing Management Global Edition, 16th Edition, Pearson Education Limited.
